title: The Roof Knows How to Wait
songTitle: The Roof Knows How to Wait
summary: Rubella inventories a ceiling that has not fallen yet. Natural ventilation. The extra bar is the plaster still deciding.
visualArc: Hole and stars → low chandelier → bored under the draft → glasses and berries → chandelier keeps its job → extra bar, piano late.

segments.label: Hole, stars
segments.onScreen: Ballroom ceiling hole, stars, plaster dust, two glasses, berries.
segments.lyrics: We said we'd leave before the roof came down. / Turns out the roof knows how to wait.
segments.musicCue: 72 BPM wet piano; first empty bar
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Photoreal abandoned grand ballroom at night, a hole in the water-stained fresco ceiling showing stars, plaster dust hanging in chandelier light, buckled parquet, two wine glasses and scattered berries on a side table, dark glamour, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Low chandelier
segments.onScreen: Chandelier three feet too low; plaster like a seating chart; she does not brush it.
segments.lyrics: The chain decided, sometime last decade, to hang three feet low. / I do not brush it off. It knows where to sit.
segments.musicCue: Verse 1; extra bar of dust after the last line
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Wide shot of a chandelier hanging three feet too low in a ruined ballroom, plaster on the floor like a seating chart, a woman in black lace not brushing it off, moonlight through the roof, cinematic, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 28-second wide. Extra bar: nobody moves. Photoreal.

segments.label: Natural ventilation
segments.onScreen: Woman under the hole; bored, not frightened; night air.
segments.lyrics: Finally. / Natural ventilation. / The roof knows how to wait / So we stayed in the weather
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Medium shot of a glamorous bored woman in a torn black lace dress standing under a hole in a ballroom ceiling, night air moving her hair almost not at all, she looks bored not frightened, photoreal, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Glasses, berries
segments.onScreen: Two glasses, crushed berries, plaster on linen, stars in the wine.
segments.lyrics: Two glasses. Berries. A hole the size of a polite apology.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Close table: two wine glasses, crushed berries, plaster dust on white linen, stars reflected in the wine, abandoned ballroom background, cinematic, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Chandelier keeps its job
segments.onScreen: Lit chandelier, taut chain, nobody looking up.
segments.lyrics: You can keep the chandelier if it keeps its job.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: The low chandelier still lit in a ruined ballroom, chain taut, plaster drifting, no one looking up, high contrast, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Extra bar, piano late
segments.onScreen: Locked hole; dust; she steps into frame half a beat late.
segments.lyrics: The roof knows how to wait / Don't smudge the plaster / It is doing manners
segments.musicCue: Final extra bar; piano late, then gone
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Locked wide of the hole in the ceiling, dust motes only, no one moving, then a woman in black lace steps half a beat late into frame, natural ventilation, photoreal, Grok Imagine style
